risk: Information, not financial advice. Cryptoassets are risky.
privacy: No advertising trackers. The Hub remembers only your language. External wallets and the RPC may have their own policies.
headline: Energy is a necessity. Solidarity is a choice.
intro: BillPay directs part of eligible BILL trades toward electricity and heating bill assistance. Follow the fund’s rules and verifiable data on Base.
flowBody: 10% on buys and sells through the recognized liquidity pair, not ordinary transfers.
settlement: A BILL transfer does not confirm a utility provider settled an invoice.
rules: 24 hours after the fifth validation, up to 20% of the balance per transfer, and one transfer per payee every 30 days.
requestIntro: Prepare an invoice locally. The static Hub does not verify identity, receive documents or submit applications.
image: Redacted bill image (PNG, JPEG or WebP, max 5 MiB)
keepLocal: Use only a redacted or synthetic image. The file and text stay in this tab and clear when it closes.
paste: Pasting is disabled for the description; type your text.
badFile: Unreadable image, invalid format or size limit exceeded.
botIntro: Local rules flag repetitions or unusual input. They do not prove fraud, block a case or trigger a payment.
flag: Review this input. A flag is not a decision.
courtIntro: The vote is advisory. The fund contract, not a public vote, authorizes a transfer.
voteOff: Public voting is closed: without authentication and deduplication, one vote per account cannot be verified.
proofIntro: Contracts, Base data links and risks. Only officially configured addresses are used.
hazards: Risks: volatility, contract defects, limited liquidity, RPC outages, oracles and irreversible transactions.
tokenIntro: Token allocation rules and data. Protocol parameters and Base readings are distinct.
vestingToken: Founder: 90-day cliff, then 36 months linear. Growth: 48 monthly periods. Launch sell limits: 7 days.
lotsIntro: 100 pioneer lots: 10 USDC for 100,000 BILL each. Later series require the 10× launch-price TWAP threshold and an openSeries() call. One purchase per wallet.
unlockBody: 45-day cliff, then linear vesting over 30 days.
submitted: Transaction submitted. Check confirmation in your wallet or the explorer before refreshing.
txFail: Action declined or unavailable; no success is confirmed.
txOff: Purchases and claims are disabled until the official configuration is validated.
walletIntro: Connect only a wallet you control. The Hub never requests a private key or recovery phrase.
noWallet: No injected wallet detected. Use a compatible extension or WalletConnect if enabled.
validatorsIntro: A validator must have purchased a lot and meet the contract’s 30-day seniority condition. At least five validations per case are required.
validatorYes: Basic requirements met; the contract still checks each case.
validatorNo: Purchase or seniority requirement not met.
councilIntro: 10 seats, rotations no more often than every 30 days. Fund approval weights: founder 3, member 1; threshold 5.
jsRequired: JavaScript is required for Base reads and local controls.
